lines.zh: 我一次挪一寸，石子路对我来说太宽。
lines.en: I move an inch at a time; the gravel road is too wide.

lines.zh: 我的小脚踩在苔上，几乎没有声。
lines.en: My small feet cross moss almost silently.

lines.zh: 我避开裂缝，掉进去就上不来了。
lines.en: I avoid cracks; fall in and I cannot climb out.

lines.zh: 走两步我就回头看看那辆篷车。
lines.en: Every two steps I look back at the wagon.

lines.zh: 我圆得像颗鹅卵石，走路会滚。
lines.en: I am round as a cobble, so I roll as I go.

lines.zh: 我沿着箱子的边挪，那儿有阴影。
lines.en: I shuffle along the crate's edge, where there is shade.

lines.zh: 我的步子太碎，走一段要歇两回。
lines.en: My steps are tiny; two rests per stretch.

lines.zh: 草比我高，我在里面像进了林子。
lines.en: The grass is taller than me, a forest to my eyes.

lines.zh: 我顺着地板缝一路走到门口。
lines.en: I follow the floorboard seam all the way to the door.

lines.zh: 有人在后面叫我，我走得更快了。
lines.en: Someone calls after me; I scurry faster.

lines.zh: 走到你靴子边要花很久，我尽力了。
lines.en: Reaching your boot takes a while; I tried my best.

lines.zh: 我拖着影子走，影子比我大十倍。
lines.en: I drag my shadow along; it is ten times my size.

lines.zh: 小步小步，我不想被踩到。
lines.en: Little steps, little steps; I do not wish to be stepped on.

lines.zh: 那条路上的石子，我都认识。
lines.en: I know every pebble on that particular road.

lines.zh: 我从你的靴子旁绕过去。
lines.en: I go around your boot.

lines.zh: 木地板的缝宽，我得横着过。
lines.en: The floorboard gap is wide; I cross sideways.

lines.zh: 我蹲在箱角，尽量不像活物。
lines.en: I crouch in the crate's corner, trying not to look alive.

lines.zh: 我身上有些小坑，是箱子颠出来的。
lines.en: My little pits came from the wagon jolting.

lines.zh: 没人来的时候，我数箱子的钉子。
lines.en: When nobody comes, I count the nails in the crate.

lines.zh: 我听见篷车那边有铃声，很远。
lines.en: I hear a bell from the wagon, very far off.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进木屑里，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I bury myself in wood shavings, only eyes out.

lines.zh: 太阳晒过来，我的石头身子暖了。
lines.en: The sun reaches me and my stone body warms.

lines.zh: 我在等有人打开唱片机。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone to start the record player.

lines.zh: 我打盹时也支着一只耳朵。
lines.en: Even dozing, I keep one ear listening.

lines.zh: 我身上的纹路像被水磨过。
lines.en: The lines on me look worn smooth by water.

lines.zh: 那辆篷车走了，我就没地方回了。
lines.en: The wagon left, so I have nowhere to go back.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，谁也看不出我是宠物。
lines.en: I curl into a ball; nobody can tell I am a pet.

lines.zh: 有只老鼠碰我，发现我是活的。
lines.en: A rat touches me and finds that I am alive.

lines.zh: 我在箱底找到一粒麦子，留着。
lines.en: I find a grain of wheat in the crate and keep it.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见木头响。
lines.en: In the quiet I can hear the wood creaking.

lines.zh: 我把脸贴在箱壁上，凉快。
lines.en: I press my face to the crate wall; it is cool.

lines.zh: 有根线头，我拨了半天。
lines.en: There is a loose thread. I poke at it for a while.

lines.zh: 我从箱口探出半个身子看你。
lines.en: I poke half my body out of the crate to see you.

lines.zh: 你的手伸过来，我往里缩了缩。
lines.en: Your hand comes near and I shrink back a bit.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你的靴子上有泥。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the mud on your boots.

lines.zh: 你身上有唱片套的味道，纸的。
lines.en: You smell of record sleeves: paper, mostly.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，石头做的东西不眨眼。
lines.en: I do not blink; stone things never blink.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，这样好多了。
lines.en: You crouch down, and that is much better.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里那只异宠袋。
lines.en: I recognise the critter bag in your hand.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我往后缩了一点点。
lines.en: When you laugh I retreat just a little.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只小爪，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I lift one small paw, which counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛很大，在我面前像两口井。
lines.en: Your eyes are huge, like two wells before me.

lines.zh: 我在看你有没有带唱片来。
lines.en: I am checking whether you brought a record.

lines.zh: 你老是盯着我，我有点不好意思。
lines.en: You keep staring; I feel a little shy.

lines.zh: 我被踩了一下，好险没碎。
lines.en: I was stepped on and nearly broke apart.

lines.zh: 我身上掉了一小块，心疼。
lines.en: A little piece of me chipped off; it hurts.

lines.zh: 我滚到墙边，缩着不动。
lines.en: I roll to the wall and curl up without moving.

lines.zh: 别碰那儿，那是我最薄的地方。
lines.en: Not there; that is my thinnest spot.

lines.zh: 我疼得发不出声，石头也这样。
lines.en: Pain leaves me silent; even stone is like this.

lines.zh: 我看见自己影子在抖。
lines.en: I see my own shadow trembling.

lines.zh: 我拖着一只腿钻进木屑里。
lines.en: I drag one leg into the wood shavings.

lines.zh: 那一下让我记起被箱子颠的日子。
lines.en: That blow reminds me of the rattling crate.

lines.zh: 我还没跳舞，别让我碎在这儿。
lines.en: I have not danced yet; do not let me break here.

lines.zh: 我的裂纹里有灰，看起来更旧了。
lines.en: Dust settles in my cracks, making me look older.

lines.zh: 那唱片一放，我的脚就自己动了。
lines.en: One record spins and my feet move by themselves.

lines.zh: 有音乐，我什么都愿意换。
lines.en: For music I would trade almost anything.

lines.zh: 你把唱片举高，我就跟着抬头。
lines.en: You raise the disc and I raise my head with it.

lines.zh: 我不吃饼干，我吃很小很小的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat biscuits; I eat very tiny things.

lines.zh: 那粒麦子，能让我高兴一整天。
lines.en: That single grain of wheat makes my whole day.

lines.zh: 你哼起来，我停下来听。
lines.en: You hum, and I stop whatever I am doing to listen.

lines.zh: 亮闪闪的碎玻璃，我忍不住要看。
lines.en: Bright shards of glass, I cannot help but look.

lines.zh: 你把手伸进箱子，我就上前了。
lines.en: You reach into the crate and I step forward.

lines.zh: 那支曲子我听过，是篷车上的。
lines.en: I know that tune; it played on the wagon.

lines.zh: 再来一遍，就一遍行不行？
lines.en: One more time, just one more, please?

lines.zh: 我抱着你的手指转了个圈。
lines.en: I hug your finger and turn a full circle.

lines.zh: 你放了慢曲子，我跳得也慢。
lines.en: You play something slow and I dance slowly too.

lines.zh: 那颗小石头是我藏的，给你也行。
lines.en: That small stone I hid is yours, if you want it.

lines.zh: 我不贪心，只要一点声音。
lines.en: I am not greedy; I only want a little sound.

lines.zh: 唱片一响，我这块石头就会跳。
lines.en: Put a record on and this rock starts dancing.

lines.zh: 那声口哨，我的耳朵动了一下。
lines.en: At that whistle, my ear twitches.

lines.zh: 你踩过来，我一下子滚开了。
lines.en: You step near and I roll right out of the way.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的靴子上，弹回箱里。
lines.en: I hit your boot and bounce back into the crate.

lines.zh: 我们两个都停住了，我先道歉。
lines.en: We both freeze, and I apologize first.

lines.zh: 我太矮，撞到你只是轻轻一下。
lines.en: I am too short; bumping you is only a tap.

lines.zh: 撞翻的木屑里，我装作是石子。
lines.en: In the spilled shavings I pretend to be a pebble.

lines.zh: 你别抬脚，我从下面过。
lines.en: Do not raise your foot; I will pass underneath.

lines.zh: 我被门夹了一下，壳上多了个印。
lines.en: The door pinches me and leaves another mark.

lines.zh: 撞到你时我听见自己的心跳。
lines.en: Knocking into you, I hear my own heart.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音像两颗石子。
lines.en: We bump, sounding like two pebbles meeting.

lines.zh: 我退到角落，把路让出来给你。
lines.en: I retreat to the corner and leave you the way.

lines.zh: 篷车箱里还有一只，跟我一样圆。
lines.en: Another one in the wagon crate, round as me.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，像两颗鹅卵石。
lines.en: We lean together like two cobblestones.

lines.zh: 她跳舞比我好看，我不嫉妒。
lines.en: She dances better than I do, and I am not jealous.

lines.zh: 我们共用一粒麦子，一人一半。
lines.en: We share one grain of wheat, half each.

lines.zh: 她敲了三下石头，是那支曲子。
lines.en: She taps the stone three times: that tune again.

lines.zh: 我们的影子叠在一起，也只有一个。
lines.en: Our shadows overlap and become only one.

lines.zh: 冬天她会缩在我背后挡风。
lines.en: In winter she curls behind me to block the wind.

lines.zh: 我给她留了箱子里最软的角落。
lines.en: I saved her the softest corner of the crate.

lines.zh: 明年的箱子里会有两只小的。
lines.en: Next year the crate will hold two small ones.

lines.zh: 她的坑比我多，我喜欢那些坑。
lines.en: She has more pits than I do; I like them.

lines.zh: 你把我捧在手里，我一动不动。
lines.en: You cup me in your hands and I stay perfectly still.

lines.zh: 轻一点，我的腿很细。
lines.en: Gently, my legs are very thin.

lines.zh: 你把我放进异宠袋，里面很暖。
lines.en: You put me in the critter bag; it is warm inside.

lines.zh: 我抓着袋口，怕被晃掉。
lines.en: I grip the bag's mouth, afraid of being shaken out.

lines.zh: 别捏太紧，石头也会疼。
lines.en: Do not squeeze; stone can hurt too.

lines.zh: 你口袋里有饼干屑，我闻到了。
lines.en: There are biscuit crumbs in your pocket; I smell them.

lines.zh: 我原来是被装进箱子运来的。
lines.en: I was brought here packed inside a crate.

lines.zh: 抬着我走的时候，慢一点就好。
lines.en: When you carry me, just walk a little slower.

lines.zh: 我会在袋里安静，不乱动。
lines.en: I will be quiet in the bag and keep still.

lines.zh: 你放下我时，我蹭了蹭你的手。
lines.en: When you set me down, I nuzzle your hand.

lines.zh: 有只老鼠盯着我的麦子。
lines.en: A rat is eyeing my grain.

lines.zh: 那只猫跳上箱子，我缩住了。
lines.en: That cat leaps onto the crate and I freeze.

lines.zh: 有人想掀箱盖，我听见木头响。
lines.en: Someone tries the lid; I hear the wood creak.

lines.zh: 那东西比我大那么多，我还是瞪着。
lines.en: That thing is so much bigger, yet I keep glaring.

lines.zh: 我把石子往身后扒拉，藏好。
lines.en: I scrape the pebbles behind me and hide them.

lines.zh: 我弓起背，尽量显得大一点。
lines.en: I arch my back, trying to look bigger.

lines.zh: 它的影子压下来，我准备好了。
lines.en: Its shadow falls over me; I am ready.

lines.zh: 我认识那双爪子的声音。
lines.en: I know the sound of those particular claws.

lines.zh: 谁动那个袋口，我就咬谁。
lines.en: Whoever touches that bag's mouth gets bitten.

lines.zh: 我不跑，箱子后面才是我的路。
lines.en: I will not run; my way out is behind the crate.

lines.zh: 我贴着地走过去，很小声。
lines.en: I creep along the ground, very quietly.

lines.zh: 它在那儿舔爪子，我先等一等。
lines.en: It is licking its paws there; I wait first.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪近，腿在发抖。
lines.en: I edge closer step by step, legs trembling.

lines.zh: 它转过来，我立刻定住装石头。
lines.en: It turns; I instantly freeze and play stone.

lines.zh: 我从箱脚绕过去，那儿它进不来。
lines.en: I circle past the crate leg, where it cannot fit.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能咬到脚趾的距离。
lines.en: I am waiting for the distance where I can bite a toe.

lines.zh: 它踩到我藏的石子了，我很生气。
lines.en: It stepped on my hidden pebbles; now I am angry.

lines.zh: 我跟着它的尾巴走，一步不差。
lines.en: I follow its tail, not missing a step.

lines.zh: 它要是低头，就轮到我动了。
lines.en: If it lowers its head, then it is my turn.

lines.zh: 我心里数着三下，就要冲了。
lines.en: I count three in my head, about to dash.

lines.zh: 我跳上它膝头，牙齿嵌进裤脚。
lines.en: I leap onto its knee and sink my teeth into its trouser leg.

lines.zh: 我的牙小，可咬在肉上一样疼。
lines.en: My teeth are small, but they hurt just as much.

lines.zh: 我拿整颗脑袋撞它的鼻子。
lines.en: I ram its nose with my entire head.

lines.zh: 它一甩，我飞出去又爬回来。
lines.en: It shakes me off; I fly, then crawl back.

lines.zh: 这一下给我的麦子报了仇。
lines.en: That one was for my grain.

lines.zh: 我咬完就往箱子里钻，很快。
lines.en: After biting I dive into the crate, fast.

lines.zh: 我爪子划到它，留下一道白线。
lines.en: My claw rakes it and leaves a white line.

lines.zh: 它退了两步，我就停手了。
lines.en: It backs off two steps and I stop.

lines.zh: 我整只挂在它尾巴上，像个疙瘩。
lines.en: I hang on its tail like a little knot.

lines.zh: 打完我才觉得腿在抖。
lines.en: Only after the fight do I notice my legs shaking.

lines.zh: 箱盖打开，光落进来，我愣住了。
lines.en: The lid opens, light falls in, and I freeze.

lines.zh: 我从木屑里爬出来，一身碎屑。
lines.en: I crawl out of the shavings covered in bits.

lines.zh: 这是篷车，我认得这味道。
lines.en: This is the wagon; I know this smell.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，石头也跟着响。
lines.en: I stretch, and my stone body creaks along.

lines.zh: 有人把我放地上，我坐了很久。
lines.en: Someone set me on the ground and I sat there.

lines.zh: 外面比箱子里亮太多了。
lines.en: Out here is far brighter than the crate.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是找藏身的地方。
lines.en: My first act is to look for a hiding spot.

lines.zh: 新的地方，新的地板缝。
lines.en: A new place, with new gaps in the floor.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身上的木屑，很费劲。
lines.en: I shake the wood shavings off, which is tiring.

lines.zh: 我听见唱片机在很远的地方响。
lines.en: I hear a record player far away.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的石头身子裂开。
lines.en: Fire bakes my stone body until it splits.

lines.zh: 从桌上掉下去，我滚了三圈。
lines.en: I fall off the table and roll three times.

lines.zh: 沉下去听不见唱片了，我怕。
lines.en: Sinking, I can no longer hear the record; I am afraid.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，我被吹进箱子里。
lines.en: A blast throws me into the crate.

lines.zh: 箭尖蹭过篷车木箱，我只缩了一下。
lines.en: The arrow grazes the wagon crate and I only flinch.

lines.zh: 那些光缠着我，石头在发烫。
lines.en: Those lights coil around me; my stone grows hot.

lines.zh: 麦子吃完了，我开始啃木屑。
lines.en: The wheat is gone; I start gnawing shavings.

lines.zh: 雷声把我震得贴在箱底。
lines.en: Thunder flattens me against the crate's bottom.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，什么声音都没有了。
lines.en: I fall, and every sound disappears.
